text:
Rowan: Need a micro-marathon tonight 10pm20min total. Throw two songs or one short film that pairs well with a late-night tea? :tea:
Priya: Songs: Faye Webster - 'King of High School Never' (4:12) + Sufjan Stevens - 'Mystery of Love' (4:02). mellow and wistful.
Marco: Short film option: 'World of Tomorrow' (16min) 2014 by Don Hertzfeldt. weird, tiny, somehow enormous.
Lena: Or two comedy songs for energy: 'Weird Al - Eat It' (2:40) + Flight of the Conchords - 'Business Time' (2:26). chaotic but hits. :laughing:
TK: If you want visuals + vibe: watch the short 'Stutterer' (13min) then a 7min ambient music video (I can link).
Rowan: Ooh Marco's pick sounds perfect for the brainfog vibe. Anyone got a streaming link?
Marco: Vimeo link: https://vimeo.com/136000000 (works in US)
Priya: Quick poll: :coffee: for chill/nostalgic, :popcorn: for funny/light, :fire: for weird-deep.
Rowan: :coffee:
Lena: :popcorn:
TK: :fire:
Priya: Poll looks split. lean towards chill. OK decision: World of Tomorrow OR Faye+Sufjan if you want music-only.
Lena: Also, shoutout to Rowan for organizing the rooftop playlist last week 10/10 great vibes. :clap:
kudos-bot: @Rowan received a Kudos from @Lena for "rooftop playlist curation".
Rowan: thanks!! brought cookies too.
TK: If you end up going weird-deep, FYI there's a 12-minute short documentary 'The Lost Arcade' that's oddly soothing.
Priya: Saved all links. I'll run the short film in the kitchen projector at 8:45 if anyone swings by. low-key watch party.
Marco: I'll bring more tea.
Rowan: Perfect. Closing with a tiny reading rec for in-between: Ken Liu short story 'The Paper Menagerie' (5-7min). Gets you in the feels real quick.
Lena: crying on cue. :sob:
Rowan: See y'all in the kitchen!
